transcript:
ጠያቂ: ሰላም። በኤቢሲ ኮንስትራክሽን የሥራ ሁኔታዎችን የሚገመግም ገለልተኛ ቡድን ወክዬ እየደወልኩ ነው። ከኩባንያው ወክዬ አልደወልኩም። ጥቂት ጥያቄዎችን ልጠይቅዎት እችላለሁ?
ሠራተኛ: አዎ፣ ይቀጥሉ።
ጠያቂ: እናመሰግናለን። ዕድሜዎ ስንት ነው?
ሠራተኛ: ሃያ ሁለት ዓመቴ ነው።
ጠያቂ: አሁን በኤቢሲ ኮንስትራክሽን እየሰሩ ነው?
ሠራተኛ: አዎ፣ እየሰራሁ ነው።
ጠያቂ: መቼ ነው ሥራ የጀመሩት?
ሠራተኛ: ክረምቱ ካለፈ በኋላ ጀመርኩ።
ጠያቂ: የትኛው ወር እንደነበር ያስታውሳሉ?
ሠራተኛ: ወሩን አላስታውስም። ዝናቡ ካቆመ በኋላ ነበር።
ጠያቂ: ከመስቀል በፊት ነበር ወይስ በኋላ?
ሠራተኛ: እርግጠኛ አይደለሁም። በዚያ አካባቢ ሊሆን ይችላል።
ጠያቂ: ሲቀጠሩ በሳይቱ ላይ ምን ሥራ እየተሰራ እንደነበር ያስታውሳሉ?
ሠራተኛ: መሠረቱን እየቆፈሩ እንደነበር ይመስለኛል።
ጠያቂ: እናመሰግናለን። በተለመደ ሳምንት ስንት ቀን ይሰራሉ፣ በቀን ስንት ሰዓት አካባቢ?
ሠራተኛ: ስድስት ቀን፣ በቀን ሰባት ሰዓት።
ጠያቂ: በተለመደ ወር ስንት ያገኛሉ?
ሠራተኛ: ስምንት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ብር።
ጠያቂ: ኩባንያው ማንኛውንም ስልጠና ሰጥቶዎታል?
ሠራተኛ: አዎ፣ አንድ ስልጠና ተከታትያለሁ።
ጠያቂ: ከፈለጉ ሥራውን ለመልቀቅ ነፃ ነዎት? የመታወቂያ ሰነዶችዎን እርስዎ ይይዛሉ?
ሠራተኛ: ከፈለግኩ መልቀቅ እችላለሁ። ወረቀቶቼ ከእኔ ጋር ናቸው።
ጠያቂ: በግል ምክንያት ከሌሎች ሠራተኞች በተለየ ሁኔታ ተስተናግደዋል?
ሠራተኛ: አይ፣ እንደዚያ አላየሁም።
ጠያቂ: የሠራተኞች ማኅበር አለ? ለመቀላቀልም ነፃ ነዎት?
ሠራተኛ: አዎ፣ ኮሚቴ አለ፣ መቀላቀል እችል ነበር።
ጠያቂ: እናመሰግናለን፣ ይህ ሁሉ ነው።

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: ሰላም። በኤቢሲ ኮንስትራክሽን የሥራ ሁኔታዎችን የሚገመግም ገለልተኛ ቡድን ወክዬ እየደወልኩ ነው። ከኩባንያው ወክዬ አልደወልኩም። ጥቂት ጥያቄዎችን ልጠይቅዎት እችላለሁ?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Hello. I am calling on behalf of an independent team that reviews working conditions at ABC Construction. I am not calling on the company's behalf. May I ask you a few questions?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Yes, go ahead.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Thank you. How old are you?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I am twenty two years old.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Are you currently working at ABC Construction?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Yes, I am working there.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: When did you start working there?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I started after the rainy season passed.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Do you remember which month it was?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.text: ወሩን አላስታውስም። ዝናቡ ካቆመ በኋላ ነበር።
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I do not remember the month. It was after the rain stopped.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Was it before or after Meskel?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.text: እርግጠኛ አይደለሁም። በዚያ አካባቢ ሊሆን ይችላል።
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I am not sure. It could be around that time.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: ሲቀጠሩ በሳይቱ ላይ ምን ሥራ እየተሰራ እንደነበር ያስታውሳሉ?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Do you remember what work was being done on the site when you were hired?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I think they were still digging the foundation.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: እናመሰግናለን። በተለመደ ሳምንት ስንት ቀን ይሰራሉ፣ በቀን ስንት ሰዓት አካባቢ?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Thank you. In a normal week, how many days do you work, and about how many hours a day?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Six days, seven hours a day.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: What do you earn in a normal month?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Eight thousand five hundred birr.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Has the company given you any training?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Yes, I attended one training.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: ከፈለጉ ሥራውን ለመልቀቅ ነፃ ነዎት? የመታወቂያ ሰነዶችዎን እርስዎ ይይዛሉ?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Are you free to leave the job if you want? Do you keep your own identity documents?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.text: ከፈለግኩ መልቀቅ እችላለሁ። ወረቀቶቼ ከእኔ ጋር ናቸው።
transcript_turns.english_gloss: I can leave if I want. My papers are with me.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: በግል ምክንያት ከሌሎች ሠራተኞች በተለየ ሁኔታ ተስተናግደዋል?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Have you been treated differently from other workers for a personal reason?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.english_gloss: No, I have not seen that.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.text: የሠራተኞች ማኅበር አለ? ለመቀላቀልም ነፃ ነዎት?
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Is there a workers' association? And are you free to join it?

transcript_turns.speaker: worker
transcript_turns.text: አዎ፣ ኮሚቴ አለ፣ መቀላቀል እችል ነበር።
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Yes, there is a committee, and I could join.

transcript_turns.speaker: interviewer
transcript_turns.english_gloss: Thank you, that is everything.
